say:1:1060402001:1.text: Stay away from the camp ahead, sir. There's a lot of gruglins!
say:1:1060402001:1.male: Stay away from the camp ahead, sir. There's a lot of gruglins!
say:1:1060402001:1.female: Stay away from the camp ahead, miss. There's a lot of gruglins!

say:2:1060402002:1.text: The Dusk Patrollers are out there, but it's just the two of them up against a horde of gruglins. I wonder how much time they'll need to clear those gruglins...
say:2:1060402002:1.source_cn: 薄暮的哥哥姐姐已经过去了。不过他们只有两个人，咕布林倒...

say:3:1060402003:1.text: You could wait right here if you're not on something urgent. When they are back, you'll be safe to enter the camp!
say:3:1060402003:1.source_cn: 你要是不着急，就在这里等他们回来吧，到时候就安全了！
